title: E-FRC-0166: where the D4 field confines: a beta0 scan of the coupled Sigma(648) rule under the modified action, with...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0166 in the gauge arena: where the D4 field confines: a beta0 scan of the coupled Sigma(648) rule under the modified action, with the cooling moves and the heat-assisted drain, at $N_t = 4$, finds the Polyakov loop falling from 0.4 to under 0.03 across a first-order transition near beta0 = 7.1 (susceptibility peak at fill 0.04), half the hypercubic 13, and registers the confined point fill 0.08, beta0 5.88.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
